source_phrase: The maximum length of a name is 63 characters.
At least one digit in a label shall be nonzero.
A scalar-int-constant-name shall be a named constant of type integer.
The value of kind-param shall be nonnegative.
If both kind-param and exponent-letter appear, exponent-letter shall be E.
The int-literal-constant shall not include a kind-param.
digit shall have one of the values 0 or 1.
digit shall have one of the values 0 through 7.
type-name shall be the name of an accessible derived type.
If module-nature is INTRINSIC, module-name shall be the name of an intrinsic module.
If module-nature is NON_INTRINSIC, module-name shall be the name of a nonintrinsic module.
A procedure-name shall be a generic name or the name of a procedure.
Named constants in scalar-expr shall have been declared earlier in the scoping unit or made accessible by use
A given dummy-arg-name shall not appear more than once in a given dummy-arg-name-list.
If the type definition contains or inherits (7.5.7.2) a deferred type-bound procedure (7.5.5), ABSTRACT shall appear.
If any allocate-object has a deferred type parameter, is unlimited polymorphic, or is of abstract type, either type-spec or source-expr shall appear.
If data-target is unlimited polymorphic, data-pointer-object shall be unlimited polymorphic, or of a type with the BIND attribute or the SEQUENCE attribute.
The type-spec or derived-type-spec shall not specify a derived type with the BIND attribute or the SEQUENCE attribute.
If RESULT appears, the entry-name shall not appear in any specification or type declaration statement in the scoping unit of the function subprogram.
A derived type type-name shall not be DOUBLEPRECISION or the same as the name of any intrinsic type defined in this document.
w shall be zero or positive for the I, B, O, Z, D, E, EN, ES, EX, F, and G edit descriptors. w shall be positive for all other edit descriptors.
predicate_a: (and (implies (in descriptor (I B O Z D E EN ES EX F G)) (ge w 0)) (implies (not-in descriptor (I B O Z D E EN ES EX F G)) (gt w 0)))

source_phrase: The name shall be the name of an abstract interface or of a procedure that has an explicit interface. || If name is declared by a procedure-declaration-stmt it shall be previously declared. || If name denotes an intrinsic procedure it shall be one that is listed in Table 16.2.
predicate_a: (and (or (abstract-interface name) (explicit-interface-procedure name)) (implies (procedure-declaration name) (declared-earlier name)) (implies (intrinsic-procedure name) (in-table-16-2 name)))
